Package mars

Class Mars

java.lang.Object
mars.util.ModelListenable
mars.Mars
public class Mars extends ModelListenable
MARS (Memory Array Redcode Simulator). This class acts as the main engine for the Core War game. It manages the memory (RAM), the cycle execution, the process queue, and the victory conditions.

    • emptyFifo

      public void emptyFifo()
      Clears the process queue entirely. Used to clean up the simulator state before a new game starts.

    • load

      public void load(String code1, String code2) throws InvalidInstructionException
      Prepares and initializes a new game by loading two warriors into memory. Clears the RAM and the process queue, parses the provided Redcode strings, and places the warriors in the ram.
      Parameters:
      code1 - The Redcode source code of the first warrior.
      code2 - The Redcode source code of the second warrior.
      Throws:
      InvalidInstructionException

    • load

      public void load(Warrior w1, Warrior w2)
      Directly loads two Warrior objects into the memory (RAM). This method bypasses the string parsing phase (InstructionFactory), making it highly optimized and lightning-fast for generation algorithms.
      Parameters:
      w1 - The first Warrior object to be loaded into the ram.
      w2 - The second Warrior object to be loaded into the ram.

    • step

      public int step()
      Advances the simulation by exactly one instruction cycle. This method is useful for GUI animations using a Timer. It executes the next process in the queue and checks for victory conditions.
      Returns:
      -1 if the game is still running. 0 if the game ends in a Draw (loop limit reached). 1 if Warrior 1 wins. 2 if Warrior 2 wins.

    • game

      public int game(String code1, String code2) throws InvalidInstructionException
      Executes an entire match instantly without GUI updates during the process. This method is specifically designed and used for our generation algorithms, where rapid, headless simulation of matches is required.
      Parameters:
      code1 - The Redcode source code of the first warrior.
      code2 - The Redcode source code of the second warrior.
      Returns:
      0 for a Draw, 1 for a Warrior 1 victory, 2 for a Warrior 2 victory.
      Throws:
      InvalidInstructionException

    • game

      public int game(Warrior w1, Warrior w2)
      Executes an entire match instantly using direct Warrior objects. Useful for genetic algorithms.
      Parameters:
      w1 - The first Warrior object fighting in the match.
      w2 - The second Warrior object fighting in the match.
      Returns:
      0 for a Draw (time limit reached), 1 for a Warrior 1 victory, 2 for a Warrior 2 victory.
